name: Lighthouz AI
long_description:
Lighthouz is a backoffice AI solution for freight brokers, to automate AP, AR, and Collections. 

Leading freight brokers are using Lighthouz AI to automate FTL (full truckload) and LTL (less than truckload) freight bill auditing, automatically filing disputes, and invoicing customers. 

With Lighthouz, 70%-85% emails do not need to be touched by humans. 

Hence, brokers using Lighthouz are invoicing customers 36% faster, getting paid 5 days sooner, and reducing back office costs by 40%.

Lighthouz brings 25+ years of supply chain, logistics, and AI experience to brokers, with a AI Professor from Georgia Tech who taught 1000+ students, and team with PhD and MS in AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science.

launches.title: Lighthouz AI: AI to automate collections for freight brokers and 3PLs
launches.tagline: Freight brokers and 3PLs collect what they're owed 5-8 days faster — without adding headcount to AR
launches.body:
Freight brokers and 3PLs run lean accounting teams that spend their days chasing money that's already earned. Every unpaid invoice means emailing a customer, checking a portal, following up again a week later, and manually deciding which accounts are actually at risk — work that scales linearly with headcount and doesn't get easier as a book of business grows. DSO creeps up not because customers refuse to pay, but because no one has time to chase every invoice consistently.

Lighthouz built Lucie, an AI collections agent purpose-built for freight finance. Lucie works customer accounts the way a best-in-class AR analyst would, just continuously and across every account at once:

* Email Collections Agent — drafts and sends context-aware payment reminders and follow-ups, escalating tone as invoices age
* Portal Collections Agent — logs into customer payment portals to check status and submit documentation, so nothing stalls waiting on a portal check
* Collections Work Queue — surfaces the accounts that actually need a human, with full context, instead of a flat list of overdue invoices
* AR Risk Dashboard — flags at-risk accounts early using payment-behavior signals, before they become write-offs

Every action Lucie takes is visible to the AR team, with clear ownership indicators showing what's automated and what's waiting on a person — collections teams stay in control of the relationship, they just stop doing the busywork.

Founders:

Srijan and Sonali are married co-founders who met at IIT during undergrad and bring 15+ years of combined AI and supply chain experience. Srijan was a CS professor at Georgia Tech, a former Google research scientist, and a Stanford postdoc with 60+ publications. Sonali spent a decade as an AI/data engineer in fintech and insurance, including at Halliburton, Progressive, and American Family.

Key Metrics:

* DSO reduction: 5-8 days faster to collect
* 30%-50% reduction in overdues 
* 45% of collections touches now automated
* One AR specialist manages 2x more accounts

Traction:

Lighthouz already powers finance operations of 40+ freight brokers and 3PLs, including Hoplite Logistics, Southern Reins Logistics, ADL, and NAD Logistics. Lighthouz AI has won the TIA 2025 and 2026 Technovator Awards.

launches.title: Lighthouz AI: AI to automate AP and AR for freight brokers and 3PLs
launches.tagline: 3PLs invoice customers within 24 hours of delivery & get paid 5 days faster
launches.body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SNdu7kqN0MY

Freight brokers and 3PLs still run AP and AR manually.

Accounting teams spend days processing carrier bills, chasing missing PODs, delaying customer invoicing, and collections efforts. Cash flow stagnates. Before Lighthouz, teams typically take 3–5 days to approve carrier bills and send customer invoices — and still miss errors like duplicate payments and invalid accessorials.

**At Lighthouz, we’ve built freight-native AI agents to automate AP and AR for brokers and 3PLs. With Lighthouz, brokers are invoicing customers within 24 hours of delivery and reduce days-to-get-paid by 5 days.** 

### **Who we are**

We’re **Srijan and Sonali**, the founders of **Lighthouz AI**. We’re part of YC S24. 

We met a decade ago during undergrad at **IIT**, have been building together ever since, and have been married for 5+ years. Srijan and Sonali have 15+ years of combined experience in AI and supply chain, building AI systems for companies like Halliburton, The Home Depot, Google, and more. 

* **Srijan** an award-winning AI scientist with **60+ publications and 6,000+ citations**.  He’s been a **CS professor at Georgia Tech**, an **ex-research scientist at Google**, completed his **postdoc at Stanford**, and earned his **PhD from the University of Maryland**.
* **Sonali** is a former **Lead AI Engineer** at **Halliburton**, **Progressive Insurance, and American Family**, specializing in **unstructured data** and building production-grade AI systems from scratch. She earned her **MS from the University of Washington**.

We’ve spent our careers building and deploying AI for complex, messy real-world data — which is exactly what freight finance looks like.

### **What Lighthouz AI does**

Lighthouz handles the entire freight billing workflow:

✅ Ingests **carrier bills, PODs, BOLs, lumpers, and invoices** from email and uploads

✅ Extracts and structures **all freight data** — rates, accessorials, remit-to, signatures, handwritten notes

✅ Verifies carrier bills against **rate confirmations / quotes**

✅ Detects exceptions like **duplicates, overbilling, missing PODs, wrong factors, and invalid accessorials**

✅ Auto-approves clean bills and routes **only true exceptions**

✅ Approves and submits **customer invoices within 24 hours of delivery**

✅ Sends automated **collections reminders** to customers pre- and post-due date 

✅ Creates a work queue for human collectors 

✅ Posts clean, validated data directly into the **TMS with full audit trails**

### **Why this matters**

Manual AP/AR quietly kills cash flow in freight. Before Lighthouz, teams typically take **3–5 days** to approve carrier bills and send customer invoices — and still miss errors like duplicate payments and invalid accessorials.

With Lighthouz:

* Processing time drops from **3–5 days → <24 hours**
* Days to get payment from customers reduces by 5 days 
* One AP specialist can process **4–5x more volume**
* Errors and rework drop dramatically
* Teams scale without adding headcount

This isn’t generic automation. Lighthouz is freight-native, built for multi-stop loads, multi-document PDFs, missing pages, rotated scans, handwritten notes, and factoring response workflows.

### **Where we are**

We are already working with leading freight brokers and 3PLs in the US and Canada. 

**Ask** ❤️

If you know freight brokers or 3PLs, please introduce us!
